messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — NewBridge POC kickoff scheduled TOMORROW 10:00am PT with their ML lead + PM. Need a short internal sync on scope, success criteria, and asks. Who can join? Agenda I propose: intros, goals, data access, eval plan, timelines, pricing/next steps.
priya: I can do it. Primary use case details? extraction from support tickets or a generative assistant?
jordan: also +1. want to know dataset size and whether they can provide a labeled gold set for eval.
alex: Primary use case is support summarization + triage assist (they called it "summaries + routing suggestions"). Scale: ~50k tickets/mo. They care about F1 for entity extraction (~0.88 target on a 500-sample set) and avg latency <400ms for 512-token responses. POC length they requested: ~4 weeks.
priya: Good. For latency we should propose two options: Hosted fast path with smaller quantized model or Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable 200 qps peaks.
jordan: For the eval I need three things from the customer: 1) anonymized 500-sample gold set (for offline F1), 2) 300-sample live-run test (to measure latency and human acceptance), 3) example prompts/templates. Ask them to drop to S3 or secure upload. Also recommend candidate models: Llama2-13B-8k (quantized) for cost/latency balance or Falcon/Redwood-verified low-latency 40B if they want quality over cost.
alex: I'll request S3 upload and confirm redaction level. They said they can redact emails but some PII might remain. Will share stakeholder list after DM.
lila: Security notes: we need to confirm data classification (PII present), SSO/SAML requirements, and whether they require customer-managed KMS. For POC we should propose retention = 30 days and TLS + at-rest encryption. Also send them the short security questionnaire and PDP template before kickoff.
derek: Pricing POV — default POC (hosted) for 4 weeks, usage billing + trial credits. If they need Dedicated for 200 qps peaks, we should propose a discounted committed trial (monthly) and size GPUs accordingly. I'll draft an estimate once we decide on expected token volume and burst profile.
priya: Action items (quick): jordan -> prompt set + eval harness; priya -> model config matrix (latency vs cost) and suggested rollout; lila -> security checklist + PDP stub; derek -> pricing draft w/ hosted vs dedicated options; alex -> get dataset link, customer timezone, and list of stakeholders.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: https://cal.newbridge/poc-kickoff (tomorrow 10:00am PT / 17:00 UTC). Attendees: alex, priya, jordan, lila, derek.
alex: I'll ask customer to provide the S3 path and confirm they can deliver the 500-sample gold set by EOD today. Also confirm whether they need on-prem or VPC-only.
priya: Sample prompt to include in the ask (copy/edit as needed):
```
System: You are an assistant that extracts {customer_name, issue_type, priority, contact_email} from a support ticket.
User: {raw ticket text}
Assistant: Return a JSON object with keys: customer_name, issue_type, priority, contact_email.
```
jordan: I'll scaffold a minimal eval harness in the newbridge repo: `github.com/redwood-inference/poc-newbridge/evals` — will include `run_eval.sh` and `metrics.json` output (precision/recall/F1). Will also stub a small sample runner to measure p95 latency against dedicated and hosted endpoints.
lila: Two additional asks before kickoff: 1) completed security questionnaire (I can send a short form), 2) a one-page architecture diagram showing where ticket data flows (customer -> S3 -> Redwood hosted/dedicated) and what we persist. I can provide templates.
derek: One more finance question to confirm with customer: expected concurrency and expected tokens per request (avg and 95th). That drives cost estimate.
alex: Thanks all — let's keep this thread for async status. I'll post the S3 link and stakeholder list once I get it. Ping here if you need me to join pre-call. :thumbsup:
priya: ack, prepping models + cost tradeoffs.
jordan: ack, will push eval scaffold tonight.
lila: sending security form now.
derek: drafting pricing and will share a short decision matrix (hosted vs dedicated) before EOD.
alex: If anyone can't make the live kickoff, please send notes and I'll cover. See you 10am.
